answer: The cedar schedule is applied in spiral and onyx shows each instalment. A payout is split which means 40% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3308 identities would post 3429 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
